component.name: Prism Console
component.summary: Controller-first Minecraft launcher for SteamOS Gaming Mode

description.p: Prism Console is an unofficial fork of Prism Launcher with a full-screen interface made for handhelds and the couch: everything works with a controller, inside SteamOS Gaming Mode, without the desktop.

ul.li: Browse and install Modrinth modpacks, update mods, and turn mods and packs on or off
Play straight into a world or server, with a clear launch screen that never looks stuck
Switch between the game and the launcher by holding View and Menu
Add any instance to Steam as its own tile, with artwork

description.p: Prism Console is not Prism Launcher and is not endorsed by or affiliated with the Prism Launcher project. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang; this project is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
